# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SQUEEZE_BREAKOUT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A contracted EMA ribbon (9-,20-,50-EMA) signals low volatility compression; a decisive breakdown below the ribbon with expanding volume often precedes a short-term bearish move. We aim to capture this edge by entering short on volume-confirmed breaks below squeezed ribbons, avoiding choppy periods and strong opening gaps.

## Mechanism
Entry: When the 9-,20-,50-EMA ribbon width (max-min) is ≤0.25× ATR(14) for three consecutive 5-min bars, AND the next 5-min bar closes below the lowest EMA of the ribbon with volume ≥2× the average 5-min volume of the prior 20 bars, enter short at the close of that bar.
Exit: Chart-stop at the highest high of the squeeze period, target 2R, or switch to a chandelier trail at 2.5× ATR.
Regime filters: Only active when VIX is between 15-25 AND time ≥10:00 ET (avoiding first 30-min noisy period); skip days where SPY moves >1% from open to open.
